diagnoses.analysis: The required-status job is an aggregate gate, not an independent test failure. Its frozen log runs exit 1 because common test0 jobs and testLatestDeps0 failed. The reusable-pr-build.yml dependency gate at lines 62-89 propagates those failures. Fixing the shared RPC metric assertion addresses the upstream PR-attributable cause; no workflow change or manual rerun is warranted.

build / common / test0 (25, hotspot) fails both client/server instancesEmitIndependentSemconv cases because RpcMetricsAdvice now intentionally retains error.type on preview call-duration metrics, while RpcInstanceSemconvTest still expects only rpc.system.name and rpc.method. RpcCommonAttributesExtractor supplies java.lang.IllegalStateException via its existing throwable fallback. The fix adds that exact expected error.type only in the preview histogram assertion. Exact legacy histogram assertions remain unchanged and both preview-only and duplicate instances are exercised. The original failure was reproduced locally, and all five affected-module suites pass after the correction, including explicit reexecution with the frozen latest-dependency CI property. The same log contains an incidental Spring Integration span-order failure followed by another execution; its task is not a failed Gradle task. Spring Integration sources are outside the PR diff and are unchanged.
evidence: Expected span to have name <nestedHandler> but was <outerAfterNested>

<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Ports the gRPC/shared-metrics slice of [#20675](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20675), excluding Thrift and Dubbo. Applies to RPC preview telemetry, including duplicate mode:

```properties
otel.semconv-stability.preview=rpc/dup
```

- **gRPC:** Use bounded status-code names for all non-OK client statuses and existing server-error statuses. Leave cancellation-only server calls without `error.type`; preserve throwable fallback, span status, exception events, and legacy telemetry.
- **Metrics:** Add `error.type` to attribute advice only for `rpc.client.call.duration` and `rpc.server.call.duration`.
- **Coverage:** Extend unary, streaming-error, cancellation, and duration assertions; update shared metrics tests and affected Sofa RPC assertions.
